verdict.rationale: Bugbot leaves inline comments with suggested fixes, and each finding has 'Fix in Cursor' and 'Fix in Web' links that hand the issue to the Cursor IDE or a cloud agent at cursor.com/agents. Both links take the developer out of the PR, and nothing shows a fix being committed directly from the review. Missing for 10: in-PR one-click apply/commit of a suggested patch, documented agent follow-up that pushes commits back to the same PR branch without leaving the PR, independent hands-on corroboration of the fix flow.
